decisions_log.decision: Tests placed in __tests__/FooterBuildDate.test.tsx (a new file) rather than added to __tests__/Footer.test.tsx
decisions_log.rationale: The design.json acceptance_tests block specifies the path __tests__/FooterBuildDate.test.tsx. The task.md also mentions Footer.test.tsx as a possible home, but the machine-readable design file is more authoritative and a separate file avoids polluting existing tests that cover unrelated footer behaviour.

decisions_log.decision: NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE is not set in package.json build script or next.config.ts
decisions_log.rationale: The deferred decision in the spec says the build pipeline (CI/container build) is responsible for providing the variable. Injecting it inside next.config.ts would require reading a file timestamp (prohibited by the Won't list). The correct injection point is NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%F) next build in the container build command, per ADR-0144.

deferred_questions.question: ts-node is not installed in this sandbox (it is an optional peer dependency of jest-config), so the Jest test suite cannot execute here. The CI workflow does not include npm test, so this does not block CI. A human should confirm the tests pass in an environment with ts-node available.
npm run build fails in this sandbox because Node.js 18 is present but Next.js requires >=20.9.0. This is a pre-existing environment constraint unrelated to this change.

files_changed.summary: Read NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE from process.env and conditionally render a 'Built: <value>' paragraph below the 'Last updated' line, using identical styling (mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400). Omits the paragraph entirely when the variable is absent or empty.
New test file covering AC1 (build date shown when env var is set) and AC2 (no 'Built:' line rendered when env var is absent).

self_assessment.notes: AC3 is a visual/DevTools check that the spec explicitly marks as requiring a human reviewer; no automated test is needed or added for it. The className on the new paragraph matches the existing 'Last updated' paragraph exactly: 'mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400'.
